headline: Intel Reports 78% Surge in AI and Data Center Revenue, Issues Weak Guidance
summary: Intel's third-quarter revenue rose 21% to $16.5 billion, driven by a 78% jump in its Data Center and AI unit. However, manufacturing disruptions, rising memory costs, and weak PC demand led the company to issue a disappointing fourth-quarter forecast.
why: Intel Corporation is a major semiconductor manufacturer and designer of microprocessors, making its quarterly earnings and forward guidance a key barometer for the health of the broader technology hardware and AI infrastructure sectors.

impacts.name: Intel Corp
impacts.why: The company reported strong Q3 revenue and AI growth paired with a disappointing final quarter forecast.

why_moved: While strong growth in data center and AI segments beat expectations, forecasted headwinds from rising component costs and weak PC demand weighed heavily on investor sentiment.
